title: Front-end Engineer (HubSpot CMS + React)
description:
Our client is seeking a front-end engineer who can bridge marketing and engineering by developing and maintaining high-quality HubSpot CMS themes and React components. They are looking for someone who writes clean, scalable code, integrates seamlessly with tools like Stripe and Google Maps, and prioritizes accessibility, performance, and user experience. The ideal candidate can take full ownership of features—from development to deployment—bringing both technical precision and design sensitivity to a fast-growing, high-impact digital environment.


What they’ll own  

  • Build and maintain HubSpot CMS theme files, custom modules, and page templates 
  • Develop and evolve the React order form that runs inside HubSpot 
  • Work on the Vite SSR app for Stripe and the small Express server that supports the form 
  • Style and UX polish across pages and modules, aligned with your theme settings 
  • Handle client-side data flow, validation, and error states 
  • Ship observability hooks and fix issues using Sentry logs 
  • Support deployments to the DigitalOcean droplet and HubSpot CMS using the HubSpot CLI 

Must-have skills  

HubSpot CMS  

  • Strong experience with HubSpot themes, custom modules, and fields.json 
  • HubL templating, partials, macros, and using HubDB where needed 
  • HubSpot CLI usage: auth, upload, hot-reload, module and theme packaging 
  • Styling within HubSpot CMS constraints, theme.json tokens, CSS variables, and scoped module CSS 

React and TypeScript  

  • React 18+ patterns that map well to React 19 
  • TypeScript in React projects, props typing, discriminated unions for form state, strict mode 
  • State management with Zustand 
  • Form handling with react-hook-form 
  • Component libraries: Ant Design, and how to customize tokens and override styles without fighting CSS 

Build tools  

  • Webpack 5 config literacy: loaders for TS, CSS/Sass, PostCSS, asset handling, code splitting 
  • Vite 5/6 for client and SSR builds 
  • Polyfills and shims in browser builds (core-js, node-polyfill-webpack-plugin, buffer/process in the browser) 

Maps and address UX  

  • Google Maps JavaScript and React wrappers 
  • Familiar with Google’s Places Autocomplete changes and using PlaceAutocompleteElement in new work 
  • Debouncing, throttling, and fallbacks for address search 

Networking and APIs  

  • Axios usage patterns, retry strategies, timeouts, and cancellation 
  • CORS, cookies or sessions for SSR endpoints, and safe handling of env variables 
  • Basic defense against scraping of serviceable locations on the client side, plus patterns to move sensitive checks server side 

Payments and checkout  

  • Stripe Elements and @stripe/react-stripe-js on the client 
  • Server-side Stripe basics in Express: creating intents, handling sessions, and error states 
  • Understanding where PCI scope starts and ends and why card data should never touch your servers 

Styling and accessibility  

  • Modern CSS with Sass and PostCSS Autoprefixer 
  • Responsive layout, motion that respects reduced motion 
  • WCAG basics, keyboard navigation, and form accessibility 

Observability and quality  

  • Sentry for React, Node, and release tracking 
  • Useful logging that ties to a customer, session, and request path 
  • Practical testing habits: component testing where it pays off, API mocks, smoke tests 

DevOps basics for your setup  

  • Comfort with a single DigitalOcean droplet running Node apps behind a reverse proxy 
  • Systemd or PM2, environment segregation, SSL renewal basics 
  • CI to build and upload to HubSpot via CLI, and to deploy Node apps 

Nice-to-have skills  

  • node-postal or libpostal familiarity, plus strategies if it is not browser-friendly 
  • SSG/SSR tradeoffs for your Vite server and caching headers 
  • Rate-limit handling and exponential backoff in the browser and server 
  • Security reviews of client code: blocking obvious scraping paths, obfuscating endpoints, gating checks on the server 
  • HubSpot APIs, CRM objects, and HubSpot Functions if you choose to use them 
  • Basic SQL for reading analytics or HubDB precompute tasks

cód. 54658


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Lead Web Designer
description:
Lead Web Designer Job Description

Location: Remote; ability to work in US EST time zone required

Type: Freelance


About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands.

We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.


The Role

We’re looking for a Lead Web Designer to own management and execution of web projects for our SaaS and B2B clients. This role is a fit for a Sr. Designer ready to step up, an Associate Design Director from a smaller shop looking to grow within a larger team, or a Lead Web Designer seeking to advance their career within a high-growth agency.

The Lead Web Designer is both hands-on and strategic: you’ll design systems, shape web content strategies, and present creative directions to clients with clarity and confidence. You’ll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the creative process from strategy through design execution, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality.
  • Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites.
  • Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability.
  • Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution.
  • Present and pitch creative work directly to clients, explaining decisions with clarity and confidence.
  • Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life.
  • Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality.
  • Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–7 years of web design experience, ideally with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end web projects: strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution.
  • Proven ability to lead client conversations and present creative directions with clarity and confidence.
  • Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences.
  • Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles.
  • Proficiency in modern design tools (Figma required; Adobe Creative Suite a plus).
  • Webflow knowledge required; familiarity with responsive best practices and handoff to development.
  • Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred.
  • Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.


Why Join BX Studio?

  • Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands.
  • Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities.
  • Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design.
  • Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;

Preferred Qualifications

This is a full-time remote role for a BIM/VDC Specialist at Eracore . The role involves utilizing BIM software for visualization and validation of electrical installations.

  • 4-7 Years of Experience with Revit
  • Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Construction Drawings skills

description:

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: Talent Development Partner
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.


Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: DevOps Pleno
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (AWS) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:

Job Purpose:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

Requirements:

Nice-to-haves:

Credentials and Experience:

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.

  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.

title: Especialista de Prompts
description:
Missão do cargo

O Especialista de Prompts atua como o arquiteto das interações entre pessoas e agentes de Inteligência Artificial, sendo responsável por traduzir necessidades humanas em comandos estruturados, claros e seguros. Seu objetivo é maximizar a precisão, a eficiência e a confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos de linguagem.

Esse profissional é o ponto de conexão entre o conhecimento do negócio e as capacidades dos modelos de IA, assegurando que as soluções corporativas entreguem resultados consistentes, éticos e mensuráveis para o desempenho das áreas.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Projetar, testar e otimizar prompts para modelos de linguagem (LLMs), aplicando técnicas avançadas como few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought e role-based prompting;
  • Desenvolver frameworks e templates reutilizáveis por área de negócio, criando bibliotecas internas de prompts com versionamento e controle de qualidade;
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade de resposta, incluindo precisão, coerência e tempo de execução, além de realizar tuning de contexto com uso de embeddings, RAG e feedback humano;
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança, confidencialidade e ética, assegurando aderência à LGPD e aos padrões de governança de IA;
  • Elaborar e manter documentação técnica, diretrizes e boas práticas de engenharia de prompts corporativos;
  • Integrar soluções de prompting com fluxos e pipelines de IA corporativa, em colaboração com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de machine learning;
  • Aplicar princípios de vibecoding para calibrar tom, estilo e empatia nas respostas dos agentes de IA, garantindo consistência com a identidade verbal da empresa;
  • Conduzir experimentos e testes A/B de prompts, utilizando metodologias de avaliação e monitoramento de performance;
  • Automatizar processos de geração, teste e avaliação de prompts por meio de Python, JSON Schema e pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Promover treinamentos e ações de evangelização interna sobre boas práticas de IA generativa;
  • Comunicar resultados e ganhos de produtividade, traduzindo dados técnicos em informações estratégicas e executivas.


Formação e experiência desejadas

  • Graduação em Engenharias, Linguística Computacional ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em engenharia de prompts, processamento de linguagem natural (NLP) ou aplicações de IA generativa;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Conhecimentos técnicos

  • Plataformas e bibliotecas: LangChain, Tess, PromptLayer, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace Transformers, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini API;
  • Linguagens e ferramentas: Python, JSON Schema, Regex, Git, VS Code, Notion e Jupyter;
  • Técnicas de otimização: Few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, function calling, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);
  • Métricas e testes: BLEU, ROUGE, factual consistency, toxicity filters, RLHF e testes A/B;
  • Governança e conformidade: versionamento, anonimização de dados, logs auditáveis, filtros de segurança e aderência à LGPD.


Perfil profissional

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico e criativo, forte capacidade de comunicação escrita e abstração semântica, aliado a pensamento técnico e visão de negócio.

É essencial ter curiosidade, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com o uso ético e responsável da Inteligência Artificial no ambiente corporativo.


Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que está moldando o futuro das interações entre pessoas e Inteligência Artificial.

title: SAP ABAP Developer / MDG Specialist (Clean Core Focus)

title: Senior HRBP LATAM
description:
We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.


Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications


Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

  • Business Acumen: Possesses robust business knowledge (industry trends, competitors, market position)
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, influence senior leaders (VP/Director), .
  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Agility & Judgment: Demonstrates high levels of resilience, adaptability, and critical thinking to navigate ambiguity, manage high-pressure situations, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Technical Familiarity: Experience with leading HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday ) and service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow ) is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

title: Product Owner
description:

Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos.

Análise de mercado e Bench com identificação de tendências de aplicativos e canais digitais.

Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e critérios de aceitação claros.

Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras. Tomar decisões de Go/No Go da entrega na Review;

Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões

Conduzir refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas seguindo metodologias ágeis.

Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades junto aos usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.

Gerenciar os stakeholders e garantir a comunicação (estratégias e ações).



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Necessário graduação completa.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Necessário conhecimento em Scrum e frameworks ágeis.

Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou posição similar, com atuação em produtos digitais.

Vivência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis (iOS e Android).

Habilidade em análise de métricas de produto (Firebase, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar na gestão de aplicativos digitais , com foco especial no aplicativo de resultados de exames , garantindo priorização assertiva das demandas e interlocução com diferentes áreas e regionais. Procuramos alguém com experiência avançada em aplicativos digitais , que seja articulada, saiba se posicionar com clareza e tenha facilidade em conduzir conversas estratégicas com diferentes públicos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad , garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da área. Também terá atuação próxima do time digital localizado em São Paulo , influenciando e direcionando prioridades de forma indireta e estruturada.

Buscamos alguém com conhecimento aprofundado sobre as lojas da Apple e Google , incluindo políticas, publicações e boas práticas de atualização de aplicativos.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e com critérios de aceitação claros.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras.
  • Realizar análise de mercado e benchmarking para identificar tendências em aplicativos e canais digitais.
  • Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas).

title: Analista de Quality Assurance Pleno
description:
Quem somos

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção digital global, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, a Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


Sobre a Vaga

Você será responsável por entregar projetos digitais “limpos”, seguindo planos de testes e criando tickets de bugs impecáveis, conforme os protocolos de qualidade global. Também será responsável pela garantia de qualidade com foco na funcionalidade e compatibilidade dos projetos analisados. Os tickets de bugs registrados devem ser escritos do ponto de vista técnico e podem incluir sugestões de correções ou soluções alternativas. Nossos projetos são baseados principalmente em ações de marketing focadas em e-mails marketing e banners que precisam estar em conformidade com os diferentes navegadores, sistemas operacionais e dispositivos, garantindo o correto carregamentos em todos eles.


Responsabilidades

• Garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento tenha sempre a lista de todos as versões de dispositivos, sistemas operacionais e navegadores que serão usados nos testes para garantir uma entrega de qualidade.

• Assumir a propriedade dos projetos de controle de qualidade atribuídos desde o início até à entrega;

• Executar planos eficazes para controle de qualidade, revisão e auditorias, entregando projetos “limpos” e livres de bugs;

• Contribuir para o design e validar a funcionalidade dos conceitos de design;

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com gerentes de projetos e desenvolvedores para garantir a qualidade e a conclusão dos projetos no prazo;

• Desenvolver materiais de boas práticas para que os demais grupos adjacentes à tecnologia realizem suas verificações de qualidade em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do projeto.


Pré-requisitos

• Experiência com campanhas digitais com testes em E-mails e Banners;

• Bacharel em Desenvolvimento de Software, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês avançado (seu time de contato direto será global);

Vale Refeição (R$ 945,00) e Vale Alimentação (R$300,00)

Total Pass

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
Manager Regulatory Affairs – Global Labeling Product Leader

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Type: Full Time | 12 Month Fixed Term Contract (FTC)

Start Date: ASAP


About the Company:


Our client is a global healthcare leader specializing in innovative pharmaceutical and medical products that improve patient outcomes worldwide. With a strong focus on quality, safety, and compliance, the company operates across multiple therapeutic areas and global markets. The successful candidate will join a collaborative Regulatory Affairs organization driving excellence in labeling compliance and product lifecycle management.


Position Summary:


The Manager Global Labeling Product Leader is responsible for the development maintenance and quality oversight of primary and derived product labeling documents across global markets. This position ensures that labeling content is compliant with international regulations and internal quality standards while contributing to global labeling strategy and product lifecycle management.

You will act as a key liaison between cross functional teams including Regulatory Affairs Safety Medical and Commercial to deliver consistent compliant and scientifically accurate product information.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation revision and maintenance of primary and derived labeling documents (for example CCDS USPI SmPC) ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and company strategy.
  • Collaborate cross functionally with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) through Labeling Working Groups (LWG) and Labeling Committees (LC) to gain consensus on labeling content.
  • Develop labeling text supported by clinical preclinical and safety data considering competitor and market context.
  • Ensure the accuracy clarity and scientific integrity of labeling documents through effective data review and documentation traceability.
  • Support the implementation of global labeling strategies including the development of target labeling for new and existing products.
  • Partner with Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and Global Labeling Operations (GLO) to ensure dissemination and alignment of labeling deliverables.
  • Maintain up to date understanding of global labeling regulations (EU US and international) CIOMS guidance and industry best practices.
  • Support audits inspections and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) management related to labeling activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to optimize labeling processes and documentation quality.
  • Provide labeling support and guidance to regional and local operating companies ensuring compliance across markets.


Qualifications and Experience


Essential:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences Pharmacy or a related discipline .
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry with at least 3 years in Regulatory Affairs and product labeling.
  • Proven understanding of global labeling regulations (FDA EMA CIOMS) and regulatory documentation standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret clinical and technical data and translate findings into compliant labeling text.
  • Strong skills in scientific writing data interpretation and document management systems (DMS) .
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work in a matrixed cross functional environment .
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word with working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint .


Desirable:

  • Advanced degree (MS PhD MD or PharmD) in a life sciences discipline.
  • Experience leading projects or small teams in a global regulatory or labeling capacity.
  • Previous participation in process improvement or compliance initiatives .
  • Experience with labeling systems and tools supporting compliance and document traceability.


Key Competencies

  • Strong scientific and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality orientation.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • Clear and professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem solving and decision making mindset.
  • Collaborative customer focused and continuous improvement driven approach.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.

  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central

Pronto para a primeira fase? Estamos à sua espera!


Tratamento de Dados Pessoais

Os dados pessoais recolhidos pela AUBAY PORTUGAL, na qualidade de Responsável pelo Tratamento, relativos à identificação, contacto e competências profissionais dos candidatos neste processo, serão tratados para efeitos de análise da candidatura, considerando que o tratamento é efetuado com base na execução de diligências pré-contratuais a pedido do titular dos dados.

Os dados pessoais enviados através da presente candidatura serão conservados pela Aubay durante todo o procedimento de recrutamento e permanecerão armazenados enquanto atualizados (por um período de dois anos).

Os dados recolhidos poderão ser transferidos ou estar sujeitos a outras operações de tratamento, desde que o titular dos dados seja informado, no âmbito de um processo padrão de candidatura e seleção, e para o cumprimento de obrigações legais durante o período exigido por lei.

Para quaisquer questões ou pedidos relacionados com os direitos de proteção de dados pessoais, o titular dos dados poderá contactar a sede da AUBAY PORTUGAL, na Avenida Duque D’Ávila, nº 46, em Lisboa, ou através do e-mail do Encarregado de Proteção de Dados (DPO) –

O titular dos dados tem igualmente o direito de apresentar reclamação junto da Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD) –

(Nota: Por favor, não inclua dados relativos à origem racial ou étnica, opiniões políticas, crenças religiosas ou filosóficas, dados biométricos, dados de saúde, vida sexual ou orientação sexual, nem informações sobre condenações penais ou infrações.)

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture

title: Especialista de Arquiteto de Soluções
description:

Experiência de trabalho comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções ou função similar.


Experiência em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de sistemas.


Inglês intermediário ou fluente.


Conhecimentos em arquitetura de software: Capacidade de compreender e projetar sistemas complexos.


Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem: usando Kubernetes e Openshift para eficiência e escalabilidade dos serviços.


Conhecimentos em segurança: Capacidade de projetar e implementar soluções de integração que sejam seguras e protegidas.


Conhecimento técnico: Sólidos conhecimentos em várias linguagens de programação, sistemas operacionais e bancos de dados.


Conhecimento de tecnologias de integração: Familiaridade com ferramentas e tecnologias de integração, como plataformas de integração de aplicativos (APIs), plataformas de integração de eventos (ESBs) como Kafka e RabbitMQ e de ferramentas de ETL.


Conhecimento de ferramentas de IA, Devops, CI/CD, monitoramento.




Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:




• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;


• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Escala: Segunda á sexta - feira.


Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Reports to: Director of Engineering


Position Overview

The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining our company’s core business applications. We’re seeking a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual should be equally comfortable working on both the front-end (React) and back-end (PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL) of modern web applications and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.


Strong English communication skills are essential for this role, as you’ll be working closely with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams. You should be able to clearly articulate technical concepts, document your work effectively, and participate in discussions and code reviews with confidence.


What You Will Do

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP and PostgreSQL .
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using React and modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enhance our company’s product line and ensure optimal system performance.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and reliability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help define technical direction for new features and system improvements.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in full stack development, contributing ideas for process and tool improvements.
  • Mentor, guide, and provide technical support to junior developers and team members.
  • Communicate effectively with non-technical teams and management to explain technical solutions in a clear, professional manner.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation to ensure knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability of code.


What You Will Bring

  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested code (samples may be requested).
  • Strong understanding of PHP , PostgreSQL , and SQL , with hands-on experience in designing, optimizing, and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or other modern front-end frameworks for building scalable, interactive web interfaces.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality, reliable software.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills , with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working in agile, team-based environments .
  • Experience in the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • Enjoys documenting code and processes, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving both personal and team skills.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, and globally distributed environment .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development, including both back-end and front-end technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects from conception to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) principles and agile methodologies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Golang)

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Experience: 8+ years overall

Engagement: Contractor

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in Golang , Node.js , and React to develop and enhance high-performance, scalable backend services. The role emphasizes Go, gRPC, Kafka, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development across AWS and GCP . You will be responsible for building robust backend services, integrating with MongoDB , streaming data via Kafka , and ensuring reliability in containerized environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain data-intensive Go and Node.js gRPC APIs.
  • Build, containerize, and deploy scalable Go microservices on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE).
  • Refactor and modernize legacy Node.js services into idiomatic Go for improved performance and stability.
  • Integrate and operate Apache Kafka pipelines for high-throughput event streaming.
  • Leverage AWS and GCP cloud services to build resilient, cost-effective solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues promptly.
  • Conduct code reviews , mentor junior engineers, and promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, and security.
  • Participate in architectural design reviews , focusing on scalability, fault tolerance, and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Program Management, and QA.
  • Provide realistic level of effort (LOE) estimates during planning cycles.
  • Prototype and experiment with emerging technologies to improve engineering velocity.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building production-grade, highly scalable Go services.
  • Expertise in writing high-performance gRPC and REST clients/servers, including protobuf contracts.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (stream processing, topic management, schema registry, ACLs, consumers, offsets).
  • 3+ years of experience with AWS (S3, CloudFront, EKS, etc.).
  • 1+ year of experience with GCP (Cloud Storage, Kafka, GKE, CDN, etc.).
  • 2+ years of experience designing and using MongoDB .

Nice to Have

  • 2+ years developing full-stack applications using Node.js , MongoDB , Express , and React .
  • 3+ years of experience with EKS/GKE , Helm , Terraform , and CI/CD pipelines .
  • 1+ year of Linux bash scripting for automation and ops tasks.
  • Exposure to Redis , Docker , Git , and observability stacks (Prometheus , Grafana , OpenTelemetry ).
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills in a globally distributed team.
  • Experience with MongoDB schemas , indexing, and sharding strategies.
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and CRUD operations .

title: Console Porting Developer (Unreal Engine 5 | PS5 + Xbox Series X|S)
description:
Astral Clocktower Studios is seeking an experienced Console Porting Developer strongly familiar with Unreal Engine to help bring our upcoming dark fantasy ARPG, Kristala, to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.


You’ll work closely with our internal engineering and QA teams to optimize performance, integrate platform services (trophies, achievements, profiles, saves), and ensure both builds meet full certification compliance on schedule.


Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions of Kristala using Unreal Engine 5
  • Implement and test platform-specific services and UI
  • Manage performance, packaging, and certification-readiness builds
  • Collaborate with our existing dev and QA team to fix bugs and meet TRC/XR requirements
  • Assist with submission and partner portal processes (Sony + Microsoft)


Requirements:

  • Solid Unreal Engine 4/5 development experience (C++ and Blueprint familiarity).
  • At least one shipped console project on PS and XB
  • Strong understanding of PS5 and/or Xbox X|S SDKs
  • Experience with Razor/PIX Profiling Tools
  • Familiarity with certification processes and common TRC/XR pitfalls
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with a distributed team
  • Self-sufficient problem solver with a detail-oriented mindset


Bonus Points:

  • Experience with both platforms (PS + Xbox)
  • Prior work on Soulslike or action RPG titles
  • Passion for animals, metal music, and dark fantasy worlds


Why Join Us?

Astral Clocktower Studios is a global, diverse team that has worked together for several years to bring Kristala to life. Our developers come from all over the world, united by a shared passion for storytelling, creativity, and the dark fantasy worlds we build together.


We foster a positive, collaborative environment where every team member’s voice matters and we’re excited to welcome another talented developer to join us for this next chapter.


If you’re a technically sharp, team-oriented developer who loves solving challenges and wants to help bring Kristala to players worldwide, we’d love to hear from you!
